name: Taiko (kumi-daiko)
summary: Ensemble taiko: drums once played at festivals and shrines, arranged since 1951 for several players at once, each on a different drum, like the voices of a drum kit (the shime-daiko as snare, the nagado-daiko as bass drum). Taken to the concert stage by groups such as Osuwa Daiko, Ondekoza and Kodo.

evidence.note: Summary written from the drummer articles listed; not from a genre history.
